name: Pixel Art
original_description:
Describe a character, items or a scene and get pixel art in 8-bit or 16-bit style: a character sprite, a sprite sheet of animation frames, items and icons, a tileset or a full scene.

The plugin prepares a draft with the kind of asset, the bit style, the palette and the image model. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders it and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For indie game developers and pixel art fans.

Limitations: new pixel art from text only. It does not convert uploaded photos, export animated GIFs or game-engine files, or copy characters from existing games. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
